task.title: Creating a sync profile
task.shortdesc: A sync profile tells which folders to keep in step, and how often.

prereq.p: Install the desktop client first: see . You also need write access to the workspace folder you want to share.

context.p: A profile pairs one folder on this computer with one folder in your workspace.

step.cmd: Open Settings and select the Profiles tab.
Click New profile and give it a short, unique name.

info.p: The name appears in the tray menu and in the activity log.

step.cmd: Choose the local folder and the workspace folder to pair.

fig.title: How a profile pairs two folders

image.alt: A laptop folder and a workspace folder linked by two arrows through the sync service

step.cmd: Set the schedule, for example every 15 min, and click Save.

result.p: The first sync starts at once. Its settings are described in .
